name: Come Again Tours and Travels
legalName: Come Again Tours and Travels Ltd
description: Licensed Uganda tour operator for Mountain Gorilla Trekking in Bwindi, Queen Elizabeth & Murchison Falls wildlife safaris, chimpanzee tracking in Kibale, and 4x4 car hire.
paymentAccepted: Bank Wire Transfer, Credit Card, Cash

offers.name: 3 Days Bwindi Gorilla Trekking Safari
offers.description: Unforgettable encounter with endangered mountain gorillas in Bwindi Impenetrable National Park, including private 4x4 safari transport and guaranteed gorilla permit reservations.

offers.name: 3 Days Murchison Falls National Park Safari
offers.description: Classic savannah game drives, boat cruise to the base of the world's most powerful waterfall, top of the falls hike, and Big Five wildlife viewing.

offers.name: 3 Days Queen Elizabeth National Park Safari
offers.description: Tree-climbing lions of Ishasha, boat safari along the Kazinga Channel with thousands of hippos, and savannah wildlife game drives.

offers.name: 5 Days Gorilla & Queen Elizabeth Wildlife Combo
offers.description: Combine Bwindi mountain gorilla trekking with Queen Elizabeth lion tracking and Kazinga Channel boat safari in one seamless 5-day adventure.

offers.name: 4x4 Safari Land Cruiser Hire with Driver-Guide
offers.description: Customized 4x4 safari vehicle equipped with pop-up photography roof, high-lift jack, fridge, and professional English-speaking driver-guide.
